findings: Rule: gate-methods token-drift — a value with no canonical equivalent is a warning naming the missing token. | Location: src/styles.css:63 (z-index 60 skip-link), :338 (z-index 40 sheet-root), :366 (z-index 20 sticky composer), :374-375 (z-index 42/41 sheet stacking), :383/:406 (z-index 15 strip-spine); src/styles.css:341 (sheet width min(420px, calc(100vw - 24px))); src/styles.css:232 (chevron font-size 16px); src/styles.css:266 (.sk-line.short width 55%); src/styles.css:154/:171 (6px vertical padding on .spine-node and .carriage). | Observation: these literals have no counterpart in tokens.primitive.json / tokens.semantic.json / tokens.component.json; observed z-order (strip 15 < composer 20 < sheets 40/41/42 < skip-link 60) matches the contract z-order (strip < scrims < sheets, dismiss topmost within the single-sheet state; sheets cover composer). No literal contradicts an existing token. | Reproduction: grep -nE 'z-index|420px|font-size: 16px|width: 55%|padding: 6px' src/styles.css in the prototype dir; cross-check names against the three token files.

Rule: component token button.padding-y -> gap.control-padding-y (12px). | Location: src/styles.css:78 (.btn padding 10px 16px). | Observation: vertical padding is 10px (space.10) instead of the tokenized 12px; the 44px min-height floor is preserved on the same rule so the target contract is unbreached. | Reproduction: read src/styles.css:76-82 and compare against tokens.component.json button.padding-y.

Rule: unique element IDs backing tab wiring (aria-controls / aria-labelledby must resolve to exactly one node; axe duplicate-id). | Location: src/components/EvidenceWing.tsx:261 (`wing-tab-${t.id}`) and :276 (`wing-panel-${view}`), rendered twice simultaneously via src/App.tsx:622 (docked wing-right aside) and the attachment-sheet slot (DrawerSheet children) whenever the attachment sheet is open. | Observation: with the attachment sheet open, #wing-tab-browser / #wing-panel-browser (and files/github twins) exist twice in the DOM, so aria-controls/aria-labelledby are ambiguous (automated-from-source; no browser was available to execute axe). | Reproduction: open the attachment sheet at narrow width (ticket select with ?state=narrow, or Cite in wing), then evaluate document.querySelectorAll('#wing-tab-browser').length === 2.

Rule: HTML list content model (ul permits only li, script, template children). | Location: src/components/Ticket.tsx — ul.tool-list renders <div className="tool-slot"> wrappers around the ToolRow <li> elements. | Observation: div elements are direct children of ul.tool-list, breaking list semantics for assistive technology even though visual rendering is unchanged (automated-from-source via code read). | Reproduction: read src/components/Ticket.tsx ToolRow call-site wrapper (class tool-slot, styled display:contents at styles.css:233).

Rule: State Matrix row B2 (Running tool row: trigger step-started, status word Running). | Location: src/fixtures.ts (all tool fixtures) + src/App.tsx startRun/retry/interrupt tool constructors + src/components/Ticket.tsx toolStatusWord. | Observation: no fixture or stub constructor emits tool status 'running'; every in-flight step renders 'staged' (word Staged), so the Running tool-row word never renders distinctly from B3 and B2 has no fixture trigger at tool-row granularity (turn-level running A3/C2 is covered). | Reproduction: grep -rn "status: 'running'" src/fixtures.ts src/App.tsx in the prototype dir — zero tool-level hits; compare toolStatusWord('running') vs rendered staged rows.

Rule: State Matrix row D6 (follow-ups offered by the latest turn only). | Location: src/App.tsx sessionFollowUps (selectedTurn?.followUps ?? active.suggestions). | Observation: the composer offers the SELECTED turn's follow-ups, not the latest turn's; the long session boots with selected=27 (failed turn with follow-ups ['Retry the migration', 'Show the lock holder']) while latest=30, so ?state=long offers a non-latest turn's suggestions on load; used labels are still filtered per D7. | Reproduction: load http://127.0.0.1:4179/?state=long and read the Suggestions group under the composer; read App.tsx sessionFollowUps useMemo. inclusion of corresponding tests.
